healthy.dialogue:
Welcome to the Pokémon Center!
All your Pokémon look perfectly healthy.
Come back anytime!

dialogue:
I see some of your Triad cards
are looking a bit worn out.

Select up to 6 and I'll restore
them to full health right away!

Ah, there you are!
I've been meaning to ask you something.

I ordered a special parcel from
the Poké Mart in Viridian City.

It's been weeks and it still
hasn't arrived. Most peculiar.

Could you check on it for me?
I'd go myself, but my research
has me absolutely swamped!

 *He hands you a slip of paper*

The Poké Mart in Viridian City
should have it waiting for you.
Keep at it, trainer!

You found it! I knew I could
count on you.

Hand it over and let's see
what we're working with!
I hope these will go to good use.

To make a complete guide on all
the Pokémon in the world…
That was my dream!

But, I'm too old! I can't do it!
So, I want you to fulfill my
dream for me!

Get moving! This is a great
undertaking in Pokémon history!

Welcome to the Poké Mart!
How can I help you today?

"Oh, you're from Pallet Town?"

The shopkeeper's eyes light up
with recognition.

He reaches under the counter and
pulls out a dusty package.

"This came for Professor Oak ages
ago! Would you mind delivering it?
It's been taking up space for weeks!"

viridian_center.title: 🏥 POKÉMON CENTER
viridian_center.content:
A warm, welcoming place to rest and heal your Pokémon.

Nurse Joy smiles as you enter.

"Would you like me to heal your Pokémon?"

viridian_route2.title: 🛣️ ROUTE 2
viridian_route2.content:
The path north leads toward Viridian Forest and Pewter City.

Best to finish your business in town before heading out.

item_found_generic.title: 📦 Item Found!
item_found_generic.content:
You found a Poké Ball along the path!

It might come in handy for catching wild Pokémon.

catch_challenge.content: A rare {cardName} has been spotted here! Catch it to complete this challenge.
